messages:
marta: Heads-up y'all 1010 heavy drizzle turned the 2nd-floor bike area into a slip'n'slide. If you parked there, check your pedals and shoes.
sam: Ugh, thanks. N-Judah just posted a temporary reroute between Church and Embarcadero due to flooded tracks. Took my bus instead. :tram:
ops-bot: TRANSIT UPDATE: N-JUDAH REROUTE via Market St between Church St and Embarcadero due to water over tracks. Expect ~15-25 min delays. https://sfgov.org/muni/alerts
kelly: If anyone's stranded near SoMa, I'm driving through the lot at noon and have 2 spare seats. DM me. :oncoming_automobile:
leo: Photo of the 3rd st underpass 12 (imgur.com/abc123)  — water level knee-high, cyclists hopping over with sketchy confidence. :sweat_smile:
ade: Caltrain stretched delays this morning, looks like a disabled freight blocking the junction. Received an email: "service restoration in progress". ETA was 40 min when I left Millbrae.
notify-bot: FACILITY: Main lobby floor mats replenished. If you tracked in a swamp, please wipe soles before elevator. Maintenance ref: LOB-9812.
marta: Also lost one of those foldable umbrellas (black/green). If found please tag me. I left a sticky note on the bike-rack board.
nina: Quick poll: are folks okay with morning standup staying virtual if delays persist? React with :raised_hand: to keep virtual, :speech_balloon: to keep in-person.
sam: :raised_hand: leaning virtual until tomorrow at least.
kelly: :speech_balloon: I can make it in but will be dripping pride.
ade: FYI for drivers: 5th St between Howard and Mission has water over the curb. Street crews en route.
marta: Thanks for the rideshare offers, Kelly. I'm grabbing the spare desk shoes from the front closet at 11:45. Leave a note if you want to borrow.
leo: Also saw a soggy pair of bright orange trainers by the rack, if that's yours they
re taped to the bulletin board.
marta: Legend. coffee's on me later for anyone who braves the commute. :coffee:
nina: Thanks all. Stay safe, and remember the stairwell's less wet than the elevator this morning.
